t: Heavy duty thermal gloves combine durable split leather and polyester with a thermal fleece lining to keep hands warm and comfortable, even in the harshest conditions. Includes finger loop for hanging / storing gloves when not in use. Split leather knuckle strip for extra durability. Hi-vis orange fabric and reflective tape ensure visibility in low-light situations, for both safety and warmth. Orange / white, x large.
